name: Warako — PDF Scanner
short: Scan to searchable PDF, sign forms, read Arabic and Latin text on your phone.
full:
Less paper. More possibilities.

Warako turns worksheets, receipts, letters, forms and ID cards into clean PDFs, and helps you find them again by any word written on the page.

SCAN
• Capture up to 50 pages per document with automatic edge detection, cropping and cleanup
• Batch mode for a stack of pages, and photos from your gallery turned into PDF pages
• Review every scan before saving: crop, rotate, filter, reorder or retake pages
• Photo quality check: blurry, dark or faded pages can be retaken one at a time
• ID card mode puts the front and back on one A4 page, at real size
• Import PDFs you already have
• Read QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, phone numbers, email and contacts

READ AND FIND
• Reads printed text on your phone, in Arabic and in languages written with the Latin alphabet, such as English, French, Spanish and German
• Search finds words inside your pages, not only in file names
• Your PDFs are searchable in Google Drive and other PDF apps too
• Automatic names from the document's title and date
• Built-in reader with zoom and go to page
• Read aloud with your phone's voices, at the speed you choose

SIGN AND EDIT
• Sign or fill: add your signature, text, the date or a tick, then drag them into place
• Rotate, reorder, retake or delete pages
• Combine scans, add pages, or pick pages into a new PDF

SHARE
• Share a smaller PDF that is easy to send on WhatsApp or by email
• Share a copy with a watermark, or protected with a password
• Optional backup to a Google Drive folder you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your documents stay on your phone unless you share them or back them up to your own Google Drive
• No Warako account and no Warako server: nothing is uploaded to us
• Optional lock with fingerprint, face or your screen lock

QUICK TO REACH
• Home-screen widget, Quick Settings tile and app-icon shortcuts for Scan, ID card and QR code
• Library with your own folders, categories, favourites, grid or list view
• Light, dark or system appearance
• Interface in English, Arabic, French, Spanish and German

FREE WITH ADS
Warako is free. A small banner appears on the Home, Library and Tools screens, never while you scan, review, edit or read a document. Some advanced tools, such as combining scans and password-protected sharing, are Warako Pro tools: watch a short video to use one once. Automatic Drive backup is a Pro setting; without it, watch a video and tap Back up now.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Scanning uses Google Play services, which must be installed on your phone
• Text reading works on printed text; check important text for errors. Handwriting is not supported
• Uninstalling the app deletes the documents stored in it, so back up or export important files first
